<?php
/**
 * PDF Generation Service with Audit Logging
 * Handles document creation requests and maintains compliance trail
 */

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\AuditLog;
use App\Libraries\PdfEngine;

class PdfGenerationService
{
    private PdfEngine $engine;
    private string $logPath;
    private array $allowedFonts = ['Helvetica', 'Times-Roman', 'Courier'];
    
    public function __construct(PdfEngine $engine, string $logPath = '/var/log/pdf-audit.log')
    {
        $this->engine = $engine;
        $this->logPath = $logPath;
    }

    /**
     * Generate PDF from template with user-supplied metadata
     */
    public function generateFromTemplate(array $request): string
    {
        $templateId = $this->sanitizeTemplateId($request['template_id'] ?? '');
        $metadata = $this->processMetadata($request['metadata'] ?? []);
        $outputPath = $this->resolveOutputPath($templateId);
        
        $this->engine->loadTemplate($templateId);
        $this->engine->setMetadata($metadata);
        
        $pdfContent = $this->engine->render($outputPath);
        
        $this->recordAuditEntry($request, $outputPath, strlen($pdfContent));
        
        return $outputPath;
    }

    /**
     * Process and validate metadata fields for PDF properties
     */
    private function processMetadata(array $raw): array
    {
        $processed = [];
        
        $allowedKeys = ['title', 'author', 'subject', 'keywords', 'creator'];
        
        foreach ($raw as $key => $value) {
            if (!in_array($key, $allowedKeys, true)) {
                continue;
            }
            // Validate length constraints
            if (strlen($value) > 256) {
                $value = substr($value, 0, 256);
            }
            // Sanitize for PDF object safety - remove null bytes and backslashes
            $value = str_replace(['\\', '\0'], '', $value);
            $processed[$key] = $value;
        }
        
        return $processed;
    }

    /**
     * Record generation event to audit log with structured format
     * Format: [timestamp] action=generate | user={user} | doc={title} | size={bytes}
     */
    private function recordAuditEntry(array $request, string $path, int $size): void
    {
        $user = $this->resolveUsername($request);
        $title = $request['metadata']['title'] ?? 'untitled';
        $timestamp = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        
        // Build structured log line
        $entry = $this->formatLogEntry($timestamp, $user, $title, $path, $size);
        
        file_put_contents($this->logPath, $entry, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }

    /**
     * Format a single audit log entry
     * Uses pipe-delimited fields for easy parsing by log aggregators
     */
    private function formatLogEntry(
        string $timestamp,
        string $user, 
        string $title,
        string $path,
        int $size
    ): string {
        // Encode fields to prevent log structure corruption
        $safeUser = $this->encodeLogField($user);
        $safeTitle = $this->encodeLogField($title);
        $safePath = $this->encodeLogField($path);
        
        return sprintf(
            "[%s] action=generate | user=%s | doc=%s | path=%s | size=%d\n",
            $timestamp,
            $safeUser,
            $safeTitle,
            $safePath,
            $size
        );
    }

    /**
     * Encode a field value for safe inclusion in log entries.
     * Handles common injection vectors while preserving readability.
     */
    private function encodeLogField(string $value): string
    {
        // Replace pipe characters to prevent field delimiter confusion
        $value = str_replace('|', '\\|', $value);
        
        // Neutralize percent-encoding attempts
        $value = str_replace('%', '%%', $value);
        
        // Handle newline variants - convert visible representations
        // Note: We handle the escaped sequences that might appear in input
        $value = str_replace('\\n', ' ', $value);
        $value = str_replace('\\r', ' ', $value);
        
        return $value;
    }

    /**
     * Resolve authenticated username from request context
     */
    private function resolveUsername(array $request): string
    {
        if (isset($request['auth']['username'])) {
            $username = $request['auth']['username'];
            // Alphanumeric usernames with dots and hyphens only
            if (preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$/', $username)) {
                return $username;
            }
        }
        return 'anonymous';
    }

    /**
     * Sanitize template identifier
     */
    private function sanitizeTemplateId(string $id): string
    {
        // Only allow alphanumeric and hyphens
        return preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9-]/', '', $id);
    }

    /**
     * Resolve safe output path for generated PDF
     */
    private function resolveOutputPath(string $templateId): string
    {
        $baseDir = '/var/generated/pdf';
        $filename = sprintf('%s_%s.pdf', $templateId, bin2hex(random_bytes(8)));
        return $baseDir . '/' . $filename;
    }
}
